items.source: implementationClass - the implementation class
items.translation: implementationClass - 实现类

items.source: Note: The resulting ResolvableType instance may not be Serializable.
items.translation: 注意：生成的ResolvableType实例可能不是Serializable。

items.source: field - the source field
items.translation: field - 源字段

items.source: a ResolvableType for the specified field
items.translation: 指定字段的ResolvableType

items.source: parameterIndex - the parameter index
items.translation: parameterIndex - 参数索引

items.source: a ResolvableType for the specified method parameter
items.translation: 指定方法参数的ResolvableType

items.source: Return a ResolvableType for the specified Class with pre-declared generics.
items.translation: 返回指定带有预声明泛型的 Class 的 ResolvableType。

items.source: methodParameter - the source method parameter (must not be null)
items.translation: methodParameter - 源方法参数（不能为 null）

items.source:
Use this variant when the class that declares the field includes generic
parameter variables that are satisfied by the implementation class.
items.translation: 在使用声明字段的类包含由实现类满足的泛型参数变量时，请使用此变体。

items.source: Convenience method that will get and resolve generic parameters, using the specified fallback if any type cannot be resolved.
items.translation: 这是一个将使用指定的fallback（如果无法解析任何类型）来获取并get以及resolve通用参数的便捷方法。

items.source: Convenience method that will get and resolve a specific generic parameter.
items.translation: 用于 `get` 并`resolve` 特定泛型参数的便捷方法。

items.source: Convenience method that will get and resolve generic parameters.
items.translation: 这是一个方便的方法，它将 get 和 resolve 泛型参数。

items.source: Return a ResolvableType for the specified MethodParameter.
items.translation: 返回指定MethodParameter的ResolvableType。

items.source: Return a ResolvableType for the specified MethodParameter, overriding the target type to resolve with a specific given type.
items.translation: 返回指定MethodParameter的ResolvableType，覆盖目标类型以使用给定的特定类型进行解析。

items.source: Return a ResolvableType for the specified Method return type.
items.translation: 返回指定 Method 返回类型的 ResolvableType。

items.source: Return the ResolvableType representing the component type of the array or NONE if this type does not represent an array.
items.translation: 返回表示数组组件类型的 ResolvableType，或者如果此类型不代表数组，则返回 NONE。

items.source: Determine whether this ResolvableType is assignable from the specified other type.
items.translation: 确定此ResolvableType是否可从指定的其他类型赋值。

items.source: clazz - the class to introspect (null is semantically equivalent to Object.class for typical use cases here)
items.translation: clazz - 要检查的类（在此处的典型用例中，`null` 在语义上等同于 `Object.class`）

items.source: other - the type to be checked against (as a ResolvableType)
items.translation: other - 要检查的类型（作为 ResolvableType）

items.source: constructor - the source constructor (must not be null)
items.translation: constructor - 源构造函数（不能为 null）

items.source: method - the source method (must not be null)
items.translation: method - 源方法（不能为 null）

items.source: indexes - the indexes that refer to the generic parameter (can be omitted to return the first generic)
items.translation: indexes - 指向泛型参数的索引（可省略以返回第一个泛型）

items.source: fallback - the fallback class to use if resolution fails
items.translation: fallback - 如果解析失败则使用的备用类

items.source: a ResolvableType for the specified class
items.translation: 指定类的ResolvableType

items.source: clazz - the class (or interface) to introspect
items.translation: clazz - 要检查的类（或接口）

items.source: generics - the generics of the class
items.translation: generics - 该类的泛型

items.source: a ResolvableType for the specific class and generics
items.translation: 一个针对特定类及其泛型的ResolvableType。

items.source: implementationType - the implementation type
items.translation: implementationType - 实现类型

items.source: nestingLevel - the nesting level (1 for the outer level; 2 for a nested generic type; etc)
items.translation: nestingLevel - 嵌套级别（外层为 1；嵌套的泛型类型为 2；以此类推）

items.source: a ResolvableType for the specified constructor parameter
items.translation: 指定构造函数参数的ResolvableType

items.source: a ResolvableType for the specified method return
items.translation: 指定方法返回值的ResolvableType

items.source: Attempts to follow the same rules as the Java compiler, considering whether both the resolved Class is assignable from the given type as well as whether all generics are assignable.
items.translation: 尝试遵循与 Java 编译器相同的规则，考虑 `resolved` Class 是否assignable from给定类型，以及所有 generics 是否可赋值。

items.source: A ResolvableType may be obtained from a field, a method parameter, a method return type, or a class. Most methods on this class will themselves return a ResolvableType, allowing for easy navigation. For example:
items.translation: ResolvableType 可以从 字段、方法参数、方法返回类型 或 类 获取。此类的绝大多数方法本身也会返回一个 ResolvableType，从而便于导航。例如：

items.source: If this method returns a non-null Class and hasGenerics() returns false, the given type effectively wraps a plain Class, allowing for plain Class processing if desirable.
items.translation: 如果此方法返回一个非 null 的 `Class`，且hasGenerics()返回 `false`，则给定的类型实际上包装了一个普通的 `Class`，在需要时允许进行普通的 `Class` 处理。

items.source: Returns NONE if this type does not implement or extend Collection.
items.translation: 如果此类型未实现或扩展 Collection，则返回 NONE。

items.source: Returns NONE if this type does not implement or extend Map.
items.translation: 如果此类型未实现或扩展 Map，则返回 NONE。

items.source: The nesting level refers to the specific generic parameter that should be returned. A nesting level of 1 indicates this type; 2 indicates the first nested generic; 3 the second; and so on. For example, given List<Set<Integer>> level 1 refers to the List, level 2 the Set, and level 3 the Integer.
items.translation: 嵌套级别指的是应返回的特定泛型参数。嵌套级别为 1 表示此类型；2 表示第一个嵌套泛型；3 表示第二个，依此类推。例如，对于 `List<Set<Integer>>`，级别 1 指代 `List`，级别 2 指代 `Set`，级别 3 指代 `Integer`。

items.source: If a type does not contain generics the supertype hierarchy will be considered.
items.translation: 如果类型不包含泛型，则将考虑supertype层次结构。

items.source: In contrast to equals(Object) or isAssignableFrom(ResolvableType), this works between different sources as well, for example, method parameters and return types.
items.translation: 与equals(Object)或isAssignableFrom(ResolvableType)不同，此方法也适用于不同的源之间，例如方法参数和返回类型。

items.source: Note: The resulting ResolvableType instances may not be Serializable.
items.translation: 注意：生成的ResolvableType实例可能不是Serializable。

items.source: The typeIndexesPerLevel map can be used to reference a specific generic for the given level. For example, an index of 0 would refer to a Map key; whereas, 1 would refer to the value. If the map does not contain a value for a specific level the last generic will be used (for example, a Map value).
items.translation: `typeIndexesPerLevel` 映射可用于引用给定级别的特定泛型。例如，索引 0 将引用 `Map` 键；而 1 将引用值。如果映射中不包含特定级别对应的值，则将使用最后一个泛型（例如，`Map` 值）。

items.source: If no supertype is available this method returns NONE.
items.translation: 如果没有可用的超类型，此方法将返回NONE。

items.source: See getNested(int, Map) for details.
items.translation: 详见getNested(int, Map)。

items.source: Nesting levels may also apply to array types; for example given String[], a nesting level of 2 refers to String.
items.translation: 嵌套级别也可能适用于数组类型；例如，给定`String[]`，嵌套级别为 2 指的是`String`。

items.source: If no generic is available at the specified indexes NONE is returned.
items.translation: 如果指定索引处没有泛型，则返回 `NONE`。

items.source: For example: ResolvableType.forClass(MyArrayList.class).
items.translation: 例如：ResolvableType.forClass(MyArrayList.class)。

items.source: For example: ResolvableType.forRawClass(List.class).
items.translation: 例如：ResolvableType.forRawClass(List.class)。

items.source: For example: ResolvableType.forClass(List.class, MyArrayList.class).
items.translation: 例如：ResolvableType.forClass(List.class, MyArrayList.class)。

items.source:
Use this variant when the class that declares the field includes generic
parameter variables that are satisfied by the implementation type.
items.translation: 在使用声明字段的类包含由实现类型满足的泛型参数变量时，请使用此变体。

items.source:
Use this variant when the class that declares the method includes generic
parameter variables that are satisfied by the implementation class.
items.translation: 在使用声明方法的类包含由实现类满足的泛型参数变量时，请使用此变体。

items.source: Resolve this type to a Class, returning the specified fallback if the type cannot be resolved. This method will consider bounds of TypeVariables and WildcardTypes if direct resolution fails; however, bounds of Object.class will be ignored.
items.translation: 将此类型解析为Class，如果无法解析该类型则返回指定的fallback。如果直接解析失败，此方法将考虑TypeVariables和WildcardTypes的边界；但是，将忽略Object.class的边界。

items.source: Return the underlying source of the resolvable type. Will return a Field, MethodParameter or Type depending on how the ResolvableType was constructed. This method is primarily to provide access to additional type information or meta-data that alternative JVM languages may provide.
items.translation: 返回可解析类型的底层源。根据构建 `ResolvableType` 的方式，将返回一个 Field、MethodParameter 或 Type。此方法主要用于访问其他 JVM 语言可能提供的额外类型信息或元数据。

items.source: Return this type as a ResolvableType of the specified class. Searches supertype and interface hierarchies to find a match, returning NONE if this type does not implement or extend the specified class.
items.translation: 返回此类型为指定类的 `ResolvableType`。搜索supertype和interface层次结构以查找匹配项，如果此类型未实现或未扩展指定类，则返回NONE。

items.source: Return a ResolvableType for the specified instance. The instance does not convey generic information but if it implements ResolvableTypeProvider a more precise ResolvableType can be used than the simple one based on the Class instance.
items.translation: 返回指定实例的ResolvableType。该实例不传达泛型信息，但如果它实现了ResolvableTypeProvider接口，则可以使用比基于Class 实例的简单ResolvableType更精确的ResolvableType。

items.source: Return an array of ResolvableType ResolvableTypes representing the generic parameters of this type. If no generics are available an empty array is returned. If you need to access a specific generic consider using the getGeneric(int...) method as it allows access to nested generics and protects against IndexOutOfBoundsExceptions.
items.translation: 返回一个代表此类型的泛型参数的 ResolvableType ResolvableTypes 数组。如果不可用，则返回空数组。如果需要访问特定的泛型，请考虑使用 getGeneric(int...) 方法，因为它可以访问嵌套泛型并防止出现 IndexOutOfBoundsExceptions。

items.source: Return a ResolvableType for the specified Constructor parameter.
items.translation: 返回指定 `Constructor` 参数的 `ResolvableType`。

items.source: Return a ResolvableType for the specified Field.
items.translation: 返回指定Field的ResolvableType。

items.source: Return a ResolvableType for the specified Field with the given nesting level.
items.translation: 返回指定 Field 的给定嵌套级别的 ResolvableType。

items.source: Return a ResolvableType for the specified Field with a given implementation.
items.translation: 返回指定 Field 的特定实现对应的 ResolvableType。

items.source: Return a ResolvableType for the specified Method parameter.
items.translation: 返回指定 `Method` 参数的 `ResolvableType`。

items.source: Return a ResolvableType for the specified MethodParameter with a given implementation type.
items.translation: 返回指定MethodParameter的ResolvableType，并给定实现类型。

items.source: Return a ResolvableType for the specified ParameterizedTypeReference.
items.translation: 返回指定ParameterizedTypeReference的ResolvableType。

items.source: Return the underlying Java Class being managed, if available; otherwise null.
items.translation: 返回正在管理的底层 Java Class（如果可用）；否则为null。

items.source: Return this type as a resolved Class, falling back to Object if no specific class can be resolved.
items.translation: 将此类型解析为已解决的 `Class`，如果无法解析出特定类，则回退到Object。

items.source: ResolvableType returned when no value is available. NONE is used in preference to null so that multiple method calls can be safely chained.
items.translation: 当没有可用值时返回 `ResolvableType`。优先使用 `NONE` 而非 `null`，以便安全地链式调用多个方法。

items.source: Return a ResolvableType for the specified Constructor parameter with a given implementation. Use this variant when the class that declares the constructor includes generic parameter variables that are satisfied by the implementation class.
items.translation: 返回指定 `Constructor` 参数的带有给定实现的`ResolvableType`。当声明构造器的类包含由实现类满足的泛型参数变量时，请使用此变体。

items.source: Return a ResolvableType for the specified Method parameter with a given implementation. Use this variant when the class that declares the method includes generic parameter variables that are satisfied by the implementation class.
items.translation: 返回指定 `Method` 参数的 `ResolvableType`，并给定一个实现。当声明该方法的类包含通用参数变量，且这些变量由实现类满足时，请使用此变体。

items.source: Return a ResolvableType for the specified MethodParameter with a given implementation type. Use this variant when the class that declares the method includes generic parameter variables that are satisfied by the implementation type.
items.translation: 返回指定MethodParameter的ResolvableType，并给定实现类型。在使用此变体时，声明方法的类包含通用参数变量，这些变量由实现类型满足。

items.source: Clear the internal ResolvableType/SerializableTypeWrapper cache.
items.translation: 清除内部 ResolvableType/SerializableTypeWrapper 缓存。

items.source: Check for full equality of all type resolution artifacts: type as well as TypeProvider and VariableResolver.
items.translation: 检查所有类型解析工件的完全相等性：包括 `type` 以及 `TypeProvider` 和 `VariableResolver`。

items.source: Return a ResolvableType as an array of the specified componentType.
items.translation: 返回指定 `componentType` 的数组形式的 `ResolvableType`。

items.source: Return the underling Java Type being managed.
items.translation: 返回正在管理的底层 Java Type。

items.source: Return true if this type contains at least a generic type that is resolved. In other words, this returns false if the type contains unresolvable generics only, that is, no substitute for any of its declared type variables.
items.translation: 如果此类型包含至少一个已解析的泛型类型，则返回 `true`。换句话说，如果此类型仅包含无法解析的泛型（即其声明的类型变量没有任何替代项），则返回 `false`。

items.source: Return a ResolvableType for the specified nesting level.
items.translation: 返回指定嵌套级别的ResolvableType。

items.source: Return true if this type contains generic parameters.
items.translation: 如果此类型包含泛型参数，则返回true。

items.source: Return true if this type resolves to a Class that represents an array.
items.translation: 返回 true，如果此类型解析为表示数组的类。

items.source: Determine whether this ResolvableType is assignable from the specified other type, as far as the other type is actually resolvable.
items.translation: 确定此 `<code>ResolvableType` 是否可从指定的其他类型赋值，前提是其他类型实际上是可解析的。

items.source: Determine whether the given object is an instance of this ResolvableType.
items.translation: 确定给定对象是否为该ResolvableType的实例。

items.source: Determine whether the underlying type has any unresolvable generics: either through an unresolvable type variable on the type itself or through implementing a generic interface in a raw fashion, i.e. without substituting that interface's type variables. The result will be true only in those two scenarios.
items.translation: 确定底层类型是否存在无法解析的泛型：要么是该类型上的无法解析的类型变量，要么是以原始方式实现通用接口（即未替换该接口的类型变量）。结果仅在上述两种情况下为 `true`。

items.source:
Return a String representation of this type in its fully resolved form
(including any generic parameters).
items.translation: 返回此类型的字符串表示形式，包括其完全解析的形式（包含任何泛型参数）。

items.source: the resolved Class or the Object fallback
items.translation: 解析后的 `Class` 或 `Object` 回退

items.source: true if the specified other type can be assigned to this ResolvableType; false otherwise
items.translation: 如果指定的其他类型可以赋值给此ResolvableType，则为true；否则为false。

items.source: true if the specified other type can be assigned to this ResolvableType as far as it is resolvable; false otherwise
items.translation: 如果指定的其他类型在可解析的情况下可以赋值给此`ResolvableType`，则返回`true`；否则返回`false`。

items.source: a ResolvableType representing this object as the specified type, or NONE if not resolvable as that type
items.translation: 一个表示此对象为指定类型的ResolvableType，或者如果无法解析为该类型则为NONE。

items.source: a ResolvableType for the nested level, or NONE
items.translation: 嵌套级别的 `ResolvableType`，或NONE

items.source: a ResolvableType for the specified generic, or NONE
items.translation: 指定泛型的ResolvableType，或NONE

items.source: a resolved Class or null
items.translation: 一个已解析的Class或null

items.source: the resolved Class, or null if not resolvable
items.translation: 解析后的 `Class`，或如果无法解析则为`null`

items.source: the resolved Class or the fallback
items.translation: 解析后的 `Class` 或 `fallback`。

items.source: a ResolvableType for the specified instance, or NONE for null
items.translation: 一个针对指定实例的ResolvableType，或者对于null为NONE

items.source: a ResolvableType for the specified Type
items.translation: 为指定的Type创建ResolvableType

items.source: a ResolvableType for the specified Type and owner
items.translation: 为指定的Type和所有者创建一个ResolvableType。

items.source: a ResolvableType for the specified ParameterizedTypeReference
items.translation: 一个用于指定ParameterizedTypeReference的ResolvableType。

items.source: other - the type to be checked against (as a Class)
items.translation: other - 要检查的类型（作为 Class）

items.source: typeIndexesPerLevel - a map containing the generic index for a given nesting level (can be null)
items.translation: typeIndexesPerLevel - 一个包含给定嵌套层级的通用索引的映射（可为 null）

items.source: an array of ResolvableType ResolvableTypes representing the generic parameters (never null)
items.translation: 一个表示泛型参数的 `ResolvableType ResolvableTypes` 数组（永远不会为`null`）

items.source: an array of resolved generic parameters (the resulting array will never be null, but it may contain null elements)
items.translation: 一个已解析的泛型参数数组（生成的数组永远不会为`null`，但可能包含`null`元素）

items.source: otherType - the ResolvableType to match against
items.translation: otherType - 要匹配的 ResolvableType

items.source: baseType - the base type (must not be null)
items.translation: baseType - 基础类型（不能为 null）

items.source: instance - the instance (possibly null)
items.translation: instance - 实例（可能为null）

items.source: type - the source type (potentially null)
items.translation: type - 源类型（可能为 null）

items.source: type - the source type or null
items.translation: type - 源类型或null

items.source: type - the required type (typically narrowed)
items.translation: type - 所需的类型（通常为窄化后的类型）

items.source: nestingLevel - the nesting level
items.translation: nestingLevel - 嵌套级别

items.source: nestingLevel - the required nesting level, indexed from 1 for the current type, 2 for the first nested generic, 3 for the second and so on
items.translation: nestingLevel - 所需的嵌套级别，从当前类型的 1 开始索引，第一个嵌套泛型为 2，第二个为 3，依此类推。

items.source: a ResolvableType for the specified base type backed by the given implementation class
items.translation: 为指定的基础类型创建由给定实现类支持的ResolvableType。

items.source: method - the source for the method return type
items.translation: method - 方法返回类型的来源

items.source: targetType - the type to resolve (a part of the method parameter's type)
items.translation: targetType - 要解析的类型（方法参数类型的一部分）

items.source: componentType - the component type
items.translation: componentType - 组件类型

items.source: a ResolvableType as an array of the specified component type
items.translation: 一个作为指定组件类型数组的ResolvableType。

items.source: owner - the owner type used to resolve variables
items.translation: owner - 用于解析变量的所有者类型

items.source: typeReference - the reference to obtain the source type from
items.translation: typeReference - 用于获取源类型的引用

items.source: Phillip Webb, Juergen Hoeller, Stephane Nicoll, Yanming Zhou
items.translation: Phillip Webb, Juergen Hoeller, Stephane Nicoll, Yanming Zhou

items.source: an array of resolved generic parameters
items.translation: 已解析泛型参数的数组

items.source: whether the declared type and type variables match
items.translation: 声明的类型和类型变量是否匹配

items.source: Return a ResolvableType for the specified Class, doing assignability checks against the raw class only (analogous to Class.isAssignableFrom(Class), which this serves as a wrapper for).
items.translation: 返回指定 Class 的 ResolvableType，仅针对原始类执行可赋值性检查（类似于 Class.isAssignableFrom(Class)，这是该方法的包装器）。

items.source: Return a ResolvableType for the specified Class, using the full generic type information for assignability checks.
items.translation: 返回指定Class的ResolvableType，用于进行包含完整泛型类型信息的可赋值性检查。

items.source: Return a ResolvableType for the specified Constructor parameter with a given implementation.
items.translation: 返回指定 Constructor 参数的 ResolvableType，并带有给定的实现。

items.source: Return a ResolvableType for the specified Field with a given implementation and the given nesting level.
items.translation: 返回指定 `Field` 的 `ResolvableType`，该字段具有给定的实现和嵌套级别。

items.source: Return a ResolvableType for the specified Method parameter with a given implementation.
items.translation: 返回指定 `Method` 参数的带有给定实现的`ResolvableType`。

items.source: Return a ResolvableType for the specified Type.
items.translation: 返回指定Type的ResolvableType。

items.source: Return a ResolvableType for the specified Type backed by the given owner type.
items.translation: 返回一个由给定所有者类型支持的指定 Type 的 ResolvableType。

items.source: Resolve this type to a Class, returning null if the type cannot be resolved.
items.translation: 将此类型解析为 `Class`，如果无法解析该类型则返回 `null`。

items.source: Resolve this type to a Class, returning the specified fallback if the type cannot be resolved.
items.translation: 将此类型解析为 Class，如果无法解析该类型，则返回指定的fallback。

items.source: Convenience method to return this type as a resolvable Collection type.
items.translation: 便利方法，用于将此类型返回为可解析的 Collection 类型。

items.source: Convenience method to return this type as a resolvable Map type.
items.translation: 便利方法，用于将此类型返回为可解析的 Map 类型。

items.source: ResolvableType returned when no value is available.
items.translation: ResolvableType 在不可用任何值时返回。

items.source: Return this type as a ResolvableType of the specified class.
items.translation: 将此类型作为指定类的ResolvableType返回。

items.source: Check for type-level equality with another ResolvableType.
items.translation: 检查与另一个ResolvableType的类型级相等性。

items.source: Return a ResolvableType for the specified base type (interface or base class) with a given implementation class.
items.translation: 返回指定基类型（接口或基类）的ResolvableType，并给定其实现类。

items.source: Return a ResolvableType for the specified instance.
items.translation: 返回指定实例的ResolvableType。

items.source: Return a ResolvableType representing the generic parameter for the given indexes.
items.translation: 返回一个代表给定索引的通用参数的ResolvableType。

items.source: Return an array of ResolvableType ResolvableTypes representing the generic parameters of this type.
items.translation: 返回一个代表此类型的泛型参数的 `ResolvableType ResolvableTypes` 数组。

items.source: Return a ResolvableType array representing the direct interfaces implemented by this type.
items.translation: 返回一个代表此类型实现的直接接口的ResolvableType数组。

items.source: Return a ResolvableType representing the direct supertype of this type.
items.translation: 返回一个代表此类型的直接超类型的ResolvableType。

items.source: Return true if this type contains at least a generic type that is resolved.
items.translation: 返回true，如果此类型包含至少一个已解析的泛型类型。

items.source: Return the underlying source of the resolvable type.
items.translation: 返回可解析类型的底层源。

items.source:
Determine whether the underlying type has any unresolvable generics:
either through an unresolvable type variable on the type itself
or through implementing a generic interface in a raw fashion,
i.e.
items.translation: 确定底层类型是否存在无法解析的泛型：要么是该类型上的无法解析的类型变量，要么是以原始方式实现通用接口，即。
